title: Grateful Dead Live at Merramec Community College on 1970-05-14

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with solid clarity (though New Speedway Boogie is split into three tracks); the show shines with a brisk, early‑70s Friend Of The Devil.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the fast‑paced early‑1970 performance, especially praising the energetic Friend Of The Devil and noting the overall excitement of the set. The soundboard source is generally clear, but the post‑production split of New Speedway Boogie into three separate tracks detracts from the musical continuity.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong show praise (fast pacing, standout Friend Of The Devil) combined with a good‑quality soundboard recording; minor track‑splitting issue lowers the rating slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and clear soundboard, but New Speedway Boogie is divided into three tracks, breaking continuity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set maintains a lively, faster‑paced feel typical of early ’70 shows, with fans noting the overall excitement and proper tempo.
